name: Crafting
summary: Authored recipes for tools, weapons, armour, consumables and materials: a station, a tool and a skill gate, the inputs taken and the outputs given, exactly.

parameters.doc: the time a recipe with no time row takes

extensionPoints.doc: the recipe a crafting pane picked; none stated = the first makeable in id order that the world does not forbid (makeableRecipes, each asked of the legality gate), else nothing-to-make; a parameter-level hook, not Prolog facts

assistant.summary: Crafting is core's crafting module (src/production/crafting.ts) remembered by ProductionDirector. The old station-recipe system (RecipeCraftingSystem) is retired by U50(1): kept in core, not ported.
notes: With no recipe stated, core chooses: the first recipe of the book in id order that the whole ladder (station, tool, skill, inputs) allows and the world does not forbid (a forbidden recipe is passed over), else nothing-to-make (PL.core-craft-chooser, docs/native-production.md section 3.6).
doNot: Add a chance term to a recipe: a recipe yields what it says.
Fall back to a recipe the ladder refuses when nothing is makeable: that is a refusal about a recipe nobody asked for.
